description: This file defines the TimesheetMenuConfigurator class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically for configuring the menu for timesheet views within the HRM system. It implements logic to determine which screen to display based on the request parameters and user role.

classes.name: TimesheetMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring the menu display for timesheet screens based on user request and role context.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the screen to either 'viewEmployeeTimesheet' or 'viewMyTimesheet' based on the request parameters and user role, and overrides the current module and screen accordingly.
